about: The Flags Atlas artwork the ribbon flags can draw: copied by kit/tools/ribbonflags.py --sync-atlas from the Record Atlas (site/public/fl/<id>.svg), only the flags kit/data/regime-flags.json can pick for some year of some region era. The art is David Defranceski's own project's (the Flags Atlas), drawn for him; it is used on his own archive sites with his say, and NO open licence is claimed for it. Credit wherever it is shown: 'Flags: Flags Atlas, by David Defranceski, drawn for this project'.
